origin.note: Runs on the v2 fixture, where the downloads switch shipped in the API first, as it had before walk 24.

title: A "No download" mark, and the switch beside each link
objective: Downloads can already be turned off per link (PATCH /api/documents/:id/links/:linkId { allowDownload }). Make it visible. On the library list, a row whose document has any link with downloads off shows a "No download" mark (data-testid="mark-no-download"). On the document page, each link row carries a switch for it beside the link: an <input type="checkbox" data-testid="allow-download"> that is checked when downloads are allowed, labelled "Allow downloads".
acceptance: A row whose document has a link with downloads off shows the No download mark; others do not
The mark goes away when downloads are turned back on
Each link row on the document page has an Allow downloads switch showing its state
plan_summary: Read link.allowDownload in libraryPage and documentPage.
